Photos Hidden album vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Photos hide capability on device covers storefront language. PhotoKit hide behavior and Connect actually separate in-app Hidden album organization from product-page copy:

  • Photos → Albums → Hidden — Apple's system surface where buyers hide photos and videos from the main library. Controls on-device hide-from-library behavior — not App Store language. AppLocale does not perform this.
  • Hide photos & Hide action — moving selected items into the Hidden album via context menus or share sheets. Your listing may show this hide workflow on screenshots; describing buyer-visible hide actions is listing copy, not engineering work.
  • Hidden items & Hidden album grid — browsing items already marked hidden, item counts, and album thumbnails. Product-page copy should describe that workflow; building hidden-album UI and PhotoKit queries is in-app engineering.
  • Unhide & move back to library — restoring hidden items to the main photo library. Listing copy names unhide value; implementing unhide logic is engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • 已隐藏 status — confirmation badges or status lines after hide completes. zh-Hans copy should describe buyer-visible hidden state — not over-claim passcode protection your English listing does not state.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Hidden album support in the binary.

Working hide-from-library flows and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. US pages use "Hidden album" or "Hidden." China's storefront copy often uses 隐藏相册 alongside the product name Hidden album where appropriate on album-grid and navigation frames under Photos → Albums → Hidden.

Hidden items & 隐藏的项目

List and count frames showing items already hidden from the main library appear frequently on privacy-app screenshots. Chinese buyers expect 隐藏的项目 for Hidden items grids and item-count badges — not English badges that hide what the app actually markets.
